name: The Police

whyMatters.en: London trio formed in 1977. Reggae upstrokes, new-wave tightness, and pop melody carried them from club singles to early-1980s global rock radio.
whyMatters.zh: 伦敦三人组，1977 年成立。雷鬼上击、new wave 紧凑与流行旋律，从俱乐部单曲走到 1980 年代初全球摇滚电台。

note.en: Debut-era hit; reggae upstroke and sparse arrangement.
note.zh: 出道期热单；雷鬼上击与稀疏编配。

note.en: Summers delay/chorus figure as a trio signature.
note.zh: Summers 的延时/chorus 音型成为三人组签名。

note.en: Synchronicity ballad; Copeland restraint under a stalker lyric.
note.zh: 《Synchronicity》谣曲；跟踪狂歌词下 Copeland 的克制鼓点。

interviewQuotes.text: We were a trio. That was the discipline.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Stewart Copeland

interviewQuotes.text: Reggae space made the songs breathe. Punk would have filled every gap.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Sting

lyricQuotes: Roxanne, you don't have to put on the red light
Every breath you take, every move you make

shortBio.en: Sting / Summers / Copeland, 1977–1986. Roxanne and Every Breath You Take bookend club hit and mass ballad.
shortBio.zh: Sting / Summers / Copeland，1977–1986。《Roxanne》与《Every Breath You Take》标记俱乐部热单与大众谣曲两端。

body.en: London/US/French trio, 1977–1986 (reunion 2007–08). Sting (Gordon Sumner), Stewart Copeland (ex-Curved Air), Andy Summers (Soft Machine; Eric Burdon’s Animals). Early guitarist Henry Padovani left; a Strontium 90/Elevators side path involved Mike Howlett (Gong). White reggae plus new-wave rock; Synchronicity (1983) and Shea Stadium dates mark the peak.
body.zh: 伦敦／美国／法国三人组，1977–1986（2007–08 重组）。Sting（Gordon Sumner）、Stewart Copeland（前 Curved Air）、Andy Summers（Soft Machine；Eric Burdon 的 Animals）。早期吉他手 Henry Padovani 离队；与 Mike Howlett（Gong）有过 Strontium 90／Elevators 支线。白雷鬼加 new wave；《Synchronicity》（1983）与 Shea Stadium 场次是高峰。

title.zh: new wave 流行里的雷鬼律动

body.en: Bass, sparse guitar, and Copeland’s drums under white-reggae/new-wave singles. Summers’s earlier Soft Machine and Animals work sits behind the trio sound.
body.zh: 贝斯、留白吉他与 Copeland 鼓点支撑白雷鬼／new wave 单曲。Summers 早年 Soft Machine 与 Animals 经历在三人声音背后。

alt.zh: Sting 与 The Police，亚特兰大，1979

title.zh: 一套三人组，然后各自离开

body.en:
1977–86 is essentially one cast. Tension between Sting and Copeland ends the run after Synchronicity. Later reunion tours replay the hits; the peak studio version remains the original trio.

No long classic-lineup churn—an abrupt stop after five studio albums.
body.zh:
1977–86 基本是一套人马。Sting 与 Copeland 的张力在《Synchronicity》后结束运行。后来重聚巡演重播热歌；巅峰录音室版本仍是原三人组。

没有长期经典阵容更替——五张录音室专后突然停止。

title.zh: 贝斯/人声、chorus 吉他、雷鬼鼓

body.en:
Sting writes most melodies and plays melodic bass high in the mix. Summers paints with effects more than metal leads. Copeland treats the kit like a percussion ensemble—octobans, hi-hat chatter.

The songs work when the three parts stay on one grid.
body.zh:
Sting 写大部分旋律，并把旋律贝斯推到混音高处。Summers 用效果器上色，少用金属主音。Copeland 把鼓组当打击乐合奏——八角鼓、踩镲碎语。

三声部咬在同一网格上时，歌曲才成立。

body.en:
Debut-era single: sparse arrangement, Sting’s nasal lead, Copeland’s upstroke-friendly groove.

Entry object for the whole catalog.
body.zh:
出道期单曲：编配稀疏、Sting 鼻音主唱、Copeland 适合上击的律动。

整本目录的入口对象。

body.en: Synchronicity and Every Breath You Take topped charts worldwide. The book compares Shea Stadium sell-outs to The Beatles’ 1965 success. Synchronicity held Billboard #1 for 17 weeks.
body.zh: 《Synchronicity》与《Every Breath You Take》在全球登顶。书中把 Shea Stadium 满座比作 Beatles 1965 年的盛况。《Synchronicity》在 Billboard 停留冠军 17 周。

title.zh: 朋克之后的三人流行摇滚

body.en: Amnesty International shows in 1986 preceded a failed new-album attempt. 2007–08 30th-anniversary tour sold nearly four million tickets; Sting said no further album or large tour.
body.zh: 1986 年大赦国际演出之后，新专辑尝试未成。2007–08 三十周年巡演售出近 400 万张票；Sting 表示不会再出专辑或大型巡演。

note.en: Fall Out single missed the charts. Summers joined from the Howlett project; Padovani exited.
note.zh: 单曲《Fall Out》未进榜。Summers 从 Howlett 项目加入；Padovani 离开。

note.en: Miles Copeland pushed Roxanne to A&M. Ghost in the Machine cut at George Martin’s Montserrat studio. Synchronicity sessions put Sting and Copeland in separate rooms. Sting sang on Dire Straits’ Money for Nothing (1985).
note.zh: Miles Copeland 推动《Roxanne》签约 A&M。《Ghost in the Machine》在 George Martin 的蒙特塞拉特录音室录制。《Synchronicity》录音把 Sting 与 Copeland 分在不同房间。Sting 参与 Dire Straits《Money for Nothing》（1985）和声。

note.en: Reggae-upstroke new-wave single as early chart hit.
note.zh: 雷鬼上击 new wave 单曲，早期榜单热单。

note.en: Trio reggae/new-wave writing that scaled to global ballads.
note.zh: 可放大到全球谣曲的三人雷鬼/new wave 写法。
